item.title: Self hosted services update
item.description:
I installed some new Self-Hosted services that I like recently.

Paperless - ngx

!

This is an self-hosted document manager that I host using a Docker Container I like it because it sorts out all my documents in a dashboard and I can easily search their titles , content and my more things. Paperless - ngx

Calibre - Web

!

This is an ebook management software that works with the desktop app or the docker container Im using the app and this web container is hosted using docker and now I can read books on my laptop from my Tab or Phone and easily come back to where I left off , I didnt get much time to use it

item.title: Installed KanBoard
item.description: Ok today I installed KanBoard which is a self hosted Project Management Software which I use for Spaced Repetition when studying , I use it with several columns where I have these things called recall columns where I put the names of lessons as tasks which I studied Then I have columns where there are recall in 1,3,7,21 days and also an initial stage. I first put them into Initial stage and after studying it I put into recall 1 and then I put it to a column in front or back based on my recallability for that specific lesson. This helps preserve my memory of that lesson for a long … time.

item.title: Installed SearXNG - Private & Self-hosted search engine
item.description:
Today I installed SearXNG which is a Privacy Focused Search engine which is self hosted , I personally host it using docker desktop and also the docker cli with a docker-compose.yaml file i got from a youtuber ,Here the link to that .yaml file docker-compose.yaml or the code

services:
  redis:
    container_name: redis
    image: docker.io/valkey/valkey:8-alpine
    command: valkey-server --save 30 1 --loglevel warning
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - searxng
    volumes:
      - valkey-data:/data
    cap_drop:
      - ALL
    cap_add:
      - SETGID
      - SETUID
      - DAC_OVERRIDE
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "1m"
        max-file: "1"

  searxng:
    container_name: searxng
    image: docker.io/searxng/searxng:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - searxng
    ports:
      - "8181:8080" #change 8181 as needed, but not 8080
    volumes:
      - searxng:/etc/searxng:rw
    environment:
      - SEARXNG_BASE_URL=http://your.docker.server.ip:8080/ #Change "your.docker.server.ip" to your Docker server's IP
      - UWSGI_WORKERS=4 #You can change this
      - UWSGI_THREADS=4 #You can change this
    cap_drop:
      - ALL
    cap_add:
      - CHOWN
      - SETGID
      - SETUID
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "1m"
        max-file: "1"

networks:
  searxng:

volumes:
  valkey-data: #redis storage
  searxng: #searxng storage

and it worked when i ran it the first time without any more configuration ,This is the basic interface ! and its pretty minimal and its fine - tunable if you want it to be , And you also have a Preferences page, ! where you can customize literally anything. I like because “I dont wan’t to be Sold”.Here are some useful links SearXNG docs SearXNG github

item.title: I installed glance - A nice Dashboard
item.description: Ok so today I installed Glance - A nice self-hosted dashboard application , I use it to get my news from hacker news , the weather and also an overview of my self hosted services. It looks cool , its light weight plus its super customizable ,So Its a really satisfying application to self host , Thank you to my friend Vihas for helping me build this and telling me about all these I also added a proxy + pihole setup which I can use to convert 127.0.0.1:4533 into navidrome.home , I also got that idea from Vihas heres his blog Vihas Blog !
